title: Father and Daughter, 1958 B&W Snapshot, El Prado
description: A charming black and white vintage snapshot captured on May 30, 1958, featuring a smiling father holding his young daughter Sandy on his lap outdoors in El Prado. The white border contains handwritten blue ink inscriptions reading 'Daddy & Sandy', 'May 30 - 1958', and 'El Prado'.
